samples.summary: Scope creep: new drag-move freeze-boundary refusal (`merge-move-frozen`) bundled into a merge copy/paste change. `moveRangeTo` previously allowed moving a merged block across a frozen row/column; this diff adds a new user-facing refusal on the drag-move path (plus a new `RangeOpRefusal` member and message). It is a consistent invariant with `canMergeSelection`, and the design doc records it, but it is a behavior change on a path the merge-paste feature does not need. Cost stays inside consistency/UX of an adjacent feature, hence minor.

Scope creep / cross-cutting behavior change: removing `clearCopyBuffer()` from both paste handlers (`worksheet.ts` and `spreadsheet.ts`) changes clipboard semantics for ALL pastes, not just merge-carrying ones — a second paste of the same copy now relocates formulas and reapplies range styles as an internal paste, and the copy marching-ants persist until Escape. This is defensible (and documented in docs/design/sheets/sheet.md), but it silently alters long-standing non-merge paste behavior in a merge-propagation change; existing clipboard tests/consumers of `clearCopyBuffer` now see a different lifecycle.

Inconsistent definition of "the pasted region": `planPasteMerges` deliberately uses the copied *range* translated by the delta (because a merged block's covered cells are absent from the grid), yet `selectPastedRange` still derives the post-paste selection from the grid's bounding box. After an internal paste that re-creates merged blocks (or whose right/bottom edge cells are covered), the resulting selection is narrower than the region actually written — the same reasoning the diff documents for merges was not applied to the selection that follows it.

Unrelated fix bundled: the `rangeOf` spread-to-fold rewrite (plus its two new tests) addresses a `RangeError`/argument-limit bug in a shared coordinate helper that has nothing to do with merge-aware copy/paste. It does enable reuse from `selectPastedRange` (good deduplication of the inlined bounding-box loop), so the only cost is a mixed-concern diff.

Merged blocks pasted from Google Sheets/Excel HTML are not supported: `html2grid` never reads `colspan`/`rowspan` (no occurrence anywhere in packages/sheets/src except the xlsx importer), so the most common way a user brings merged layout in from another spreadsheet still drops it. The design doc frames this as a deliberate decision, but if the originating issue's acceptance mentions pasting merged cells from an external spreadsheet, this half of the outcome is unmet.
searchedFor: grep for html2grid usage in sheet.ts
